description.value: Quarterway Liquor Store operates alongside the Quarterway Pub on Bowen Road in Nanaimo, a common BC arrangement where a licensed liquor store shares a building with a full-service pub. For touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo, it offers a convenient stop for supplies along a central arterial road. The adjacent pub provides food and drink service.

The pub website confirms an active business at this address and provides a phone number, but contains no information about the liquor store's specific amenities relevant to cyclists. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill evidence appears anywhere in the available content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Quarterway Liquor Store' (shop=alcohol) but the discovered URL leads to 'Quarterway Pub' — these are likely co-located under shared Quarterway branding, but the URL was discovered at medium confidence and may belong to the pub rather than the liquor store specifically. OSM record has no address, phone, or website tags; all contact information is drawn from the discovered pub website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business at a confirmed Nanaimo address; a liquor store is a legitimate stop for touring cyclists regardless of cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: In BC, pub-attached liquor stores are common and often share a name and address. A future validator should confirm the liquor store occupies the same address (1431 Bowen Rd) and whether the pub phone number reaches the liquor store.
